_meta.description: Rules-based mapping from SharePoint 2016 on-prem web part types to SharePoint Online modern equivalents.
_meta.notes: Grow this file with each prototype run. Each entry feeds the pipeline mapper.

webPartTypes.notes: HTML content preserved. SPO strips inline CSS on a/li/span â€” use div/table/h2 for styling.
knownLimitations: Inline styles on <a>, <li>, <span> stripped by SPO
Zero-width spaces must be stripped from source HTML

webPartTypes.architecturalNote: CAML lives in the view definition, NOT in the page. Classic: page owns CAML. Modern: list owns view (CAML), page references view by ID. Conversion must provision the view first, then wire the page web part to it.

variants.description: List view with no web part connection. Role: Primary or Secondary.
variants.spoComponent: Add-PnPPageComponent (List web part, references provisioned view)
variants.viewProvisioning: Ensure-SpoListView â€” creates CMAT_Migration_* view on target list with CAML from source. Page web part references this view by ID.
variants.notes: CurrentUser token (<UserID Type='Integer'/>) works in SPO list views. Validate: claims identity differs between SP2016 NTLM and SPO Entra â€” token resolves correctly but resolved user will differ in test vs prod.
knownLimitations: CAML must be extracted from rendered HTML or views.json â€” not from page XML
View provisioning step required before page build
CMAT_Migration_ prefix used to distinguish pipeline-created views

variants.description: List view that sends selected row value to connected consumer web parts.
variants.spoComponent: Add-PnPPageComponent (List web part, standalone view only)
variants.notes: SPO modern pages do not support classic Web Part Connection framework. Provider list view migrates as a standalone list web part â€” data displays but row-selection no longer triggers child filtering.

enhancementHook.description: SPFx component with row-click event + filtered child queries

variants.description: List view that receives filter from a connected provider. Role: Child. Captures relationship intent for future redesign.
variants.notes: Functional regression. Child panels (Tasks, Narratives, Log Entries) on case dashboard pages. Must capture relationship metadata even though not migrated â€” feeds SPFx/Power Apps redesign.

enhancementHook.description: SPFx MasterDetail component; or Power Apps canvas embed pending Protected B data classification confirmation

webPartTypes.notes: Parsed into 4-column HTML table. Icons mapped to SPO SiteAssets URLs. Native SPO section max is 3 columns â€” use OneColumn section + <table> for 4-column layouts.
knownLimitations: Click-to-expand grouping not available in static HTML
Icon images require migrate-site-assets.ps1 to run first

webPartTypes.notes: Not yet encountered in prototype runs. SPO blocks arbitrary script injection. Will need SPFx or embed approach.
SPO has a native Embed web part for iframes. Works if source URL is HTTPS and allows embedding. On-prem URLs behind VPN will not render.
Image URLs must be repointed to SPO SiteAssets after asset migration.

architecturalRules.rule: CAML lives in the view, not the page
architecturalRules.detail: Classic SP2016: CAML filter is embedded in the XsltListViewWebPart on the page. Modern SPO: CAML lives in a List View definition. Conversion pipeline must provision the view (Ensure-SpoListView) before building the page, then wire the List web part to the provisioned view by ID.

architecturalRules.rule: Detect role before mapping: Primary / Child / Secondary
architecturalRules.detail: First unconnected list view = Primary. Connected consumer = Child. Additional standalone views = Secondary. Role determines section placement and gap handling.

architecturalRules.rule: Capture relationship intent even for unmigrated web parts
architecturalRules.detail: Connected consumer web parts must record Parent.ID -> ChildList.LookupField even though they are not migrated. This metadata feeds the SPFx/Power Apps MasterDetail redesign in Opportunity 4.

architecturalRules.rule: Layout decision is data-driven, not always OneColumn
architecturalRules.detail: 1 primary list + â‰¤2 secondary elements â†’ OneColumn. 1 primary list + >2 secondary/child elements â†’ TwoColumn (70/30). Pure content pages â†’ Article layout.

architecturalRules.rule: Detection hierarchy: WebPart XML > Rendered HTML > views.json
architecturalRules.detail: Prefer WebPart XML export if accessible. Fall back to rendered HTML regex. Fall back to known views.json from 01_source_sharepoint data library. Record which method was used in manifest detectionMethod field.

layoutMappings.notes: Use Home not Article â€” Article adds unwanted gray hero banner.
Article works for content pages but adds hero section. May need hero removal post-create.

sectionMappings.notes: Use HTML <table> with 4 <td> cells inside a Text web part. SPO native max is 3 columns.
